title: Neptune Apex Reading Weekly Alarm Flag Trend
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neptune:apex alarm_flag=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(alarm_flag) as avg_duration, max(alarm_flag) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst alarm flag for Neptune Apex reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture alarm_flag on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average alarm flag with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It catches whether Neptune Apex reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
